newsitem.title: CHINA: FANGDA FIRST-HALF NET 75.65 MLN YUAN.
newsitem.headline: FANGDA FIRST-HALF NET 75.65 MLN YUAN.

text.p: Chinese building materials producer Shenzhen Fangda Industrial Co Ltd posted net profits of 75.65 million yuan for the first half of 1997, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said on Monday.
The company's per-share net reached 0.315 yuan, with net assets per share valued at 3.02 yuan at the end of June, the exchange said in a notice issued after the market closed.
The exchange did not give any comparative figures or clarify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards.

Fangda booked net profits of 45.08 million yuan for the first half of 1996 based on Chinese accounting standards. Under international standards, its net profits were 44.02 million yuan for the period.
Trading of the company's A shares and B shares would be suspended on Tuesday morning and resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.
